source_wording: 数据库 B+ 树的高度和入度计算?

answer_side_model.internal_node: f child pointers plus f-1 separator keys within usable bytes U
answer_side_model.leaf: floor(usable leaf bytes / average leaf entry bytes)
answer_side_model.height: root is level 1; full-tree capacity is L*f^(H-1)
answer_side_model.scope: capacity estimate, not exact physical engine layout
